# Anycode v0.3.6

Anycode v0.3.6 improves multibuffer scroll smoothness and stability with composited pre-warmed sticky header slots, replaces native updater confirmation dialogs with a non-blocking `UpdaterToast`, fixes agent prompt resize scroll jumps and startup reload flashes, disables dynamic background by default, and adds recent folders and configurable startup workspace behavior.

## Editor & Multibuffer Performance

- **Composited Multibuffer Sticky Headers**: Switched sticky file headers in multibuffer review to pre-warmed `position: sticky` slots inside `.anyeditor-content`, eliminating push gaps, fast-scroll frame drops, and layout shifts (`LayoutShift` 0) while updating slot geometry in-place across line edits and diff-gap expansions.
- **Bounded Layer Window & Overscroll Preservation**: Bounded mounted slots by both pixel radius (`1500px`) and file count (`MAX_SLOT_COUNT_RADIUS = 25`), preserved standby slots during negative overscroll bounce, and aligned cursor reveal padding with multibuffer header rows.

## Desktop & Updater

- **Updater Toast Notification**: Replaced blocking `window.confirm` update dialogs in `anycode-desktop` with a non-blocking React `UpdaterToast` component.

## UI & Project Switching

- **Add-Project Popover & Recent Folders**: Added recent folders to the add-project popover alongside a dedicated add-project button in `ProjectSwitcher`.
- **Cleaner Startup & Dynamic Background Defaults**: Disabled dynamic background by default, avoided welcome/background flash during reload, and removed manual `-webkit-backdrop-filter` rules in favor of bundler prefixing.

## Agent Chat & Backend

- **Agent Prompt Scroll Stability**: Prevented upward scroll jumps when resizing multi-line agent prompts and fixed auto-scroll feedback loops.
- **Configurable Startup Project**: Introduced `StartupProject` selection rules (`Select`, `IfEmpty`, `Skip`) in `WorkspaceManager` so server startup handles explicit CLI workspace paths cleanly.

**Full comparison:** `v0.3.5...v0.3.6`
